expected_issues.title: entry_args.args accessed on a plain sequence
expected_issues.description:
_evaluate_entry_args() iterates entry_args.args, but entry.args is a list/tuple, so every scheduled entry with positional args raises AttributeError and is not sent.

The helper receives `entry.args` (a sequence), not the entry. `entry_args.args` fails with AttributeError: 'list' object has no attribute 'args' for any periodic task with arguments, which beat logs and skips. Iterate over entry_args directly.

expected_issues.title: New test only covers None args; no test with positional arguments
expected_issues.description: The added test sets entry.args and entry.kwargs to None, which takes the early-return branch of the new helpers. No test schedules an entry with non-empty positional arguments, the common case, so the AttributeError in _evaluate_entry_args() is not detected.
